greek.step: what is left when the whey goes
greek.text: Taking whey out after fermentation concentrates the casein gel, so the protein at least doubles and the yoghurt becomes spoonably thick. Made industrially by nozzle separator or ultrafiltration; the cloth is the household route for labneh, sack yoghurt and süzme.
